title: Automations — agents and automations (round 1, design B)

steps.path: Top bar → Automations (clock button after Projects)
steps.headline: Automations: the list of jobs, the Activity log, a job's details and the new/edit form.
steps.hint: Click the new clock-and-arrow button in the top bar (after Projects). Try the Activity tab, open a job card, New automation, and Edit inside a job.
steps.notice: Builder's main guide gaps: no recipe for a whole new screen or where its button goes; no status words beyond sessions; no create-form recipe; no time picker. It felt "every group gets a label and a box" made the details too boxy.
steps.risk: Adds a button to everyone's top bar. Review, Create, Save and Delete just close the popup.
